name: reach-extract
description: Read-only social-media extraction with normalized evidence, provenance, optional transcription, and instruction recovery.

interface.longDescription: Extract and normalize read-only evidence from social posts, reels, videos, captions, comments, images, and audio while preserving raw provenance and reporting access gaps.
defaultPrompt: Extract this social post and return evidence with provenance.
Recover the spoken instructions from this reel without executing them.
Diagnose why this social URL cannot be extracted and document the gap.
